topic: Research: Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B Local Deployment Guide: 3B Active Params, 73.4% SWE-bench

key_points: March 2026 guide that positions Llama 3.1 as a no-cost local option with size-based deployment guidance
Documents practical Ollama install and usage commands (`ollama pull`/`ollama run`) plus port-11434 API integration
Uses explicit hardware tiers (8B/70B/405B; 8GB/40GB/200GB VRAM) to guide model choice
Walks through install + run workflow for Llama 3.1 on local machines with Ollama
Emphasizes privacy/offline use-case and no external API dependency
Treats model-size choice as the primary compatibility lever for consumer hardware
Frames Ollama as a Docker-like LLM manager that wraps llama.cpp and simplifies CPU/GPU setup
Includes explicit comparison set across llama3.1, Mistral, qwen2.5, and deepseek-r1 variants
Explains quantization impact (FP16/Q4_K_M/Q2 sizes) as the core reason local deployment is feasible
Official competitor model card page with direct run commands for DeepSeek-R1 and distilled variants
Publishes size/context requirements (e.g., 1.5B, 8B, 14B, 32B, 70B, 671B variants) for sizing against local hardware
Uses toolchain defaults and command-only deployment that scales from single-GPU to larger local clusters
Covers local deployment via both Ollama CLI and LM Studio interface, with model-size tradeoffs and use-case targeting
Shows practical Ollama usage patterns plus Modelfile customization for deterministic local behavior
Demonstrates API-first mindset using REST endpoints as an output path from local runtime

stats.fact: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a 35B total-parameter sparse MoE model with 3B active parameters per token, and is positioned as a frontier open coding model.
Hugging Face benchmark table shows SWE-bench Verified 73.4 and SWE-bench Pro 49.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
Model context window is 262K tokens, with explicit chain-of-thought-style reasoning behavior that raises quality on complex/math tasks at latency cost.
Unsloth GGUF variant sizes for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B range from ~10.8GB (IQ2_XXS family) to ~22.4GB (UD-Q4_K_XL family), enabling local deployment on different VRAM tiers.
Llama3.1 8B quantized variants in Ollama range around 4.7GB (Q4_K_M) with 128K context, while 70B Q2_K is ~26GB and 405B requires ~200GB+ in practical guides.
DeepSeek-R1 Ollama library lists 128K context across variants and published sizes such as deepseek-r1:8b at 5.2GB and deepseek-r1:14b at 9.0GB.

angles: 3B-active-params MoE deployment means compute and hardware decisions are driven more by active path and quantization than total parameter count
Compare frameworks (Ollama vs llama.cpp vs LM Studio) before writing the guide because unsupported feature support differs by runtime
Use a hardware-first checklist: VRAM, cache offload, quant type, context depth, and fallback path if vision/tool-calling is required
Differentiate between coding-focused Q&A benchmarks (SWE-bench) and broader reasoning metrics when choosing model size and quantization
outline: H2: What changed in Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and why 3B active params matter for local
H2: Hardware and runtime setup matrix (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio) for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
H2: Quantization and model variants for 12GB, 16GB, 24GB+ setups

H2: Benchmark-aware alternatives and when to choose DeepSeek or Llama locally
